## Question or hypothesis

What scientific or engineering question does this change address?

## Change

Describe the implementation and any changed assumptions.

## Evidence

List tests, experiments, configurations, data snapshots, and relevant results. State uncertainty and negative results.

## Checklist

- [ ] Unit tests and the official smoke test pass.
- [ ] No credentials, private feedback, hidden outcomes, or restricted data are included.
- [ ] New assumptions and limitations are documented.
- [ ] Submission packaging still places `model.py` at the ZIP root.
